findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: arm_price_trigger · Private data: get_track_record, disarm_price_trigger, get_trade_plan, get_signal_bias, arm_price_trigger · Public sink: get_trigger_status, disarm_price_trigger, arm_price_trigger.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: arm_price_trigger · Private data: get_track_record, disarm_price_trigger, get_trade_plan, get_signal_bias, arm_price_trigger · Public sink: get_trigger_status, disarm_price_trigger, arm_price_trigger

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_symbols" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
